Erin Manning: terms across 18 texts, 2009 to 2024

Every row is a term, set at the level of the text that first uses it (the ring). Along its row, a dot in every later text that uses it, sized by uses per 10,000 body words. Hover for numbers; click a term for its first use and more. "Glossary terms" are litmap's top 300 by count over the whole corpus; "new in this text" lists, for each text, the words and hyphenated compounds whose first use is there, from the full token table.

Click a term

The side panel shows the term's first use with its page, its candidate defining sentences (glossary terms), its uses by text, and its collocates, people and sources nearby (glossary terms).

SOURCE: litmap outputs for Erin Manning (docs.csv, viz/term_by_doc.csv, glossary/glossary.csv) and new_words_by_first_text_2026-11-11.csv, built 2026-11-11 by build_terms_timeline.py. Base: the glossary's top 300 terms for the author; 5,997 words and hyphenated compounds with 3+ uses (body text outside quotations, nouns, names, adjectives and verbs of 4+ letters, ligatures folded), of which the 400 most used per text are embedded; 18 texts (2 undated, shown last); rates are uses per 10,000 body words of each text; counts are raw uses. Terms are litmap's candidates, not the author's own list.
